rtl_result.summary: Implemented the fixed-width unsigned adder with a single elastic output register and synchronous reset.

files.purpose: Exact unsigned addition with registered ready/valid output.

contract_checks.requirement: Exactly one manifest module with frozen ports and no parameters.
contract_checks.evidence: unsigned_adder.sv defines only unsigned_adder with all nine declared ports.

contract_checks.requirement: Exact unsigned addition with explicit 9-bit extensions.
contract_checks.evidence: Both operands are zero-extended into unsigned 9-bit signals; all nine sum bits are stored, covering 0 through 510.

contract_checks.requirement: Single-entry elastic storage and one-cycle unstalled transfer latency.
contract_checks.evidence: Only out_sum and out_valid are registered. Acceptance captures the result; consumption can occur on the following edge. Input acceptance takes priority over output-only consumption to support replacement.

contract_checks.requirement: Exact readiness and stable output under backpressure.
contract_checks.evidence: in_ready implements rst_n && (!out_valid || out_ready). A full stalled slot has no state update; output-only consumption retains out_sum.

contract_checks.requirement: Active-low synchronous reset clears data and validity and suppresses transfers.
contract_checks.evidence: The rising-edge process gives reset highest priority and clears both registers. Readiness is forced low combinationally during reset.

contract_checks.requirement: Synthesizable RTL with no forbidden constructs, additional storage, or unresolved dependencies.
contract_checks.evidence: Textual review finds continuous combinational assignments and one always_ff process, single drivers, no latches, and no submodules.

known_risks: Compilation, independent functional/protocol regression, and synthesis have not been run.
